customRules.title: FastAPI auth dependency touched
customRules.detail: Auth dependencies guard routes indirectly, so small edits can make endpoints public.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Add an authorization test for protected routes before merging.

customRules.title: Raw SQL from request-shaped input
customRules.detail: Interpolated SQL or request-controlled values in execute calls can become SQL injection.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Use bound parameters and add an injection-focused test.

customRules.title: Destructive Alembic migration
customRules.detail: Schema changes that drop data need backups, rollout thinking, and a rollback path.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Confirm backup, target environment, migration plan, and rollback before applying.
